en_title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Secret Ending Cutscene Suggests a Halo 2 Remake Is on the Way
cn_title: 《光环：战役进化》隐藏结局暗示《光环2》重制版将至
subtitle: 约翰逊中士喊话「续作见」

paragraphs.en: Halo Studios seems to have teased a Halo 2 remake in a secret ending cutscene for Halo: Campaign Evolved .
paragraphs.cn: 光环工作室似乎在《光环：战役进化》的一段隐藏结局过场动画中，暗示了《光环2》重制版的存在。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft's Halo 1 remake is finally out in the wild for those who gained early access by purchasing its Premium or Collector's Editions. Just one day removed from its early launch, that means many have already blown through the game multiple times, and some have even discovered a tease for a Halo 2 remake.
paragraphs.cn: 微软的《光环》初代重制版终于向购买高级版或收藏版、获得抢先体验资格的玩家开放。抢先上线仅一天，许多人就已经多次通关，还有玩家发现了《光环2》重制版的线索。

paragraphs.en: Those who manage to beat Halo: Campaign Evolved on Legendary difficulty will be greeted with a new secret cutscene featuring none other than Sergeant Johnson (via ComicBook ). Beginning by showing him watching a clip from the original secret ending, Johnson ditches the Elite to kick up his feat on the beach. Just after catching an explosion on the ring, he makes his exit, but not before dropping that tease: "See you in the sequel."
paragraphs.cn: 在传奇难度下通关《光环：战役进化》的玩家，会看到一段由约翰逊中士登场的全新隐藏过场动画（消息来自ComicBook）。开场时，他正在观看原版隐藏结局的片段，随后甩开精英战士，到海滩上翘脚休息。目睹环带发生爆炸后，他起身离开，并在退场前留下一句意味深长的话：「续作见。」

paragraphs.en: As if that wasn't already enough, another post-credits tease offers even more evidence to suggest a Halo 2 remake is in the cards. In the scene, players can see 343 Guilty Spark flying toward a planet, likely to meet up with Arbiter and launch into the events of the original sequel game. YouTube channel GamersPrey uploaded the full ending sequence here .
paragraphs.cn: 如果这还不够，另一段片尾彩蛋又提供了更多证据，显示《光环2》重制版可能确实已在计划之中。画面里，玩家可以看到343罪恶火花飞向一颗星球，它很可能会在那里与神风烈士会合，从而引出原版续作的故事。YouTube频道GamersPrey上传了完整的结局片段。

paragraphs.en: It wouldn't be a surprise to see Halo Studios and Xbox continue with a follow-up – or maybe even two – now that a re-imagining for the original is here. However, the pair have yet to announce a proper Halo 2 remake, so the future of the series in general mostly remains a mystery, for now.
paragraphs.cn: 既然初代的重新构想版已经推出，光环工作室和XBOX继续制作一部、甚至两部后续作品也不足为奇。不过双方尚未正式公布《光环2》重制版，因此这个系列未来的整体走向目前仍然充满未知。

paragraphs.en: Last week, YouTuber Rebs Gaming and Windows Central reported that the developer had most recently canceled a Halo multiplayer game . The project was said to be being worked on by Certain Affinity under the codename "Ekur." That leaves Halo: Campaign Evolved as the only game to carry single-player fans of the franchise until more is shared in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 上周，YouTube博主Rebs Gaming和Windows Central报道称，开发团队最近取消了一款《光环》多人游戏。据称该项目由Certain Affinity参与开发，代号为「Ekur」。在官方公布更多消息之前，《光环：战役进化》也就成了系列单人模式玩家唯一可以期待的作品。

paragraphs.en: Halo 2 launched for the original Xbox in 2004 and received the remaster treatment with the Master Chief Collection in 2014. Halo: Campaign Evolved, meanwhile, will deliver its remake of the first game when it launches July 28, 2026. Until then, and until Halo Studios is willing to share more about its potential future remake plans, you can check out IGN's 7/10 review of the new game.
paragraphs.cn: 《光环2》于2004年登陆初代XBOX，并在2014年的《光环：士官长合集》中获得高清重制。《光环：战役进化》则将于2026年7月28日推出，带来初代游戏的重制体验。在游戏发售、以及光环工作室愿意透露未来潜在重制计划之前，你可以阅读IGN为本作给出的7/10分评测。

paragraphs.en: "Halo: Campaign Evolved speaks to the series' timelessness and adds a decent set of new missions," we said, "but it's mostly a lean retread that's more of a test run for its future with Unreal Engine."
paragraphs.cn: 我们在评测中表示：「《光环：战役进化》证明了这个系列经久不衰的魅力，也加入了一批还算不错的新任务，但整体上仍是一次较为精简的旧地重游，更像是在为系列使用Unreal Engine的未来进行试水。」

summary: 《光环：战役进化》传奇难度隐藏结局中，约翰逊中士以「续作见」留下线索，片尾的343罪恶火花画面也指向《光环2》的剧情。虽然光环工作室尚未正式公布重制版，但两段彩蛋让相关猜测迅速升温。
opus_summary: 传奇难度通关后，约翰逊中士的一句「续作见」，再加上343罪恶火花飞向星球的片尾画面，让《光环2》重制版的暗示几乎摆到了台面上。
